rows.context_and_review_note: Retained Colour #RRGGBB (0–9, A–F, a–f) as an understandable functional explanation of hexadecimal input without inventing an uncertain specialist term. #RRGGBB preserves the SIX RGB positions; the parentheses list accepted character ranges, not extra positions or an alpha channel. R/G/B are pattern labels, not literal permitted input letters. AdvancedColourDialog.kt:246 passes this as the visible field label and :228 as its contentDescription; it is NOT inserted into the editable value and is not the validation-error resource. :363 trims outer whitespace, then :364 accepts exactly #[0-9a-fA-F]{6}, including mixed case; :380 emits # plus six uppercase digits. Thus no shorthand, eight-digit alpha, localized numerals, missing # or embedded spaces are suggested. The single Tifinagh colour noun is grammatical as a nominal label. Longer than source, but placed above the single-line input in its column; actual wrapping, narrow-screen fit and screen-reader pronunciation of ranges remain untested.
